correctness.rationale: Unique normalization from rank-one identity and \(P^2=P\) uses \(\lambda\varphi(I_n)=1\). Nondegenerate trace pairing yields precisely E²=E, CE=EC=C, tr C=1, all fields. Geometric fibers are smooth affine-hyperplane bundles. Gaussian and complementary-subspace counts give \({n\brack r}_q q^{nr-1}\). GL_n orbit reduction gives arbitrary trace-one corner similarity; rational canonical Euler factor weighted by every nontrivial additive character gives \(K_q(z^p)\), hence the characteristic-p correction. For corank j, the normalized weights have summable \(t^{j^2}\) bounds, yielding the classical first Rogers–Ramanujan normalization. Direct original-identity enumeration on M2(F2), M2(F3) and independent trace-class counts through 3×3 match the formula. No finite census is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Provides the complete natural rank-one idempotent averaging-operator parameter variety on \(M_n(k)\), the full finite-field fiber census, a characteristic-sensitive formula for all simultaneous-conjugacy orbits, and a nondegenerate limiting corank distribution whose normalization is a Rogers–Ramanujan product. These answer distinct motivated algebraic enumeration and moduli questions for an infinite matrix-algebra family, beyond a trivial relabeling of Pei–Guo’s general range/kernel criterion. The characteristic-divisibility correction and sharp limiting law are precise meaningful invariants.
